Mapping to DATA_CONTRACT:
  > - Fig.1: results/curves.csv — one row per (split in G/T/S, subset in all/fixed_kmax, method like S6+P5, k). Columns: k,N,n_models_at_k,n_excluded_at_k,n_groups,rmse_raw,lo,hi (group-bootstrap 95%, B=5000, resample org groups),rmse_std,lo_std,hi_std,mae_raw,spearman,floor_raw (model's own all-others floor),t1_rmse_raw,t1_floor_raw (predicted by T1), rand_q10,rand_q90,rand_sd (S0 draws). Use split=G for the headline; fixed_kmax = subset with >=109 run cells (k_max=109 = floor(N/3)). Raw points = main_score*100. k* in results/kstar.csv: k_emp (9999 = not reached on the grid), k_emp_lo/hi, k_pred, per epsilon_name in {delta,2delta,delta_floor,2delta_floor} (see PREREG Addendum 1).
  > - Fig.2: results/fig2_spectrum.csv (eigenvalue, pa95, noise_edge_gd, EM-completed and mean-imputed eigs), fig2_rank_estimates.csv (estimator,r — note the estimators disagree: parallel analysis 5 vs Gavish-Donoho 56; plot all, do not pick one), fig2_cv_vs_rank.csv, fig2_coverage.csv (model x task 0/1), fig2_task_types.csv, fig2_summary.json.
  > - Fig.4/Table2 contrast: results/contrast_S6_vs_S0.csv. NOTE sign: gain_mean = RMSE(S0) - RMSE(S6) (>0 = design better); diff_mean = -gain_mean to match the contract's S6-minus-S0 sign. lo90/hi90/lo95/hi95 are bounds on gain_mean, so check which sign your axis needs; delta (=Delta here; equal), delta_floor (secondary margin), verdict (primary delta), verdict_floor, n_groups.
  > - Table 1: results/table1_filter.csv, table1_splits.csv, table1_shape.json. Excess-over-floor curves (empirical vs T1) for Fig.3 input: results/excess_curve_{G_all,G_fixed_kmax,S_all,T_all}.csv.
